requirements.title: The system shall allow a logged-in shopper to apply one promo code per order.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid code, when the shopper applies it, then the order total is reduced by the configured discount
Given a second code, when the shopper applies it, then the first code is replaced and only one discount applies

requirements.title: The system must reject expired or unknown promo codes with a clear message.
acceptance_criteria: Given an expired code, when applied, then "This code has expired" is shown and the total is unchanged
Given an unknown code, when applied, then "Code not recognised" is shown

requirements.title: The promo field must accept 4 to 20 alphanumeric characters.
As a returning shopper, I want my applied code to persist if I refresh the page, so that I don't have to re-enter it.
Applying a promo code should respond in under 1 second at p95.
The promo field must be operable by keyboard and announced by screen readers (WCAG 2.2 AA).
